description: List the relations PubTator 3 has extracted for a gene, disease, chemical or variant — which drugs treat a disease, which genes a disease is associated with, which chemicals inhibit a gene — ranked by supporting-publication count, each labelled machine-extracted, and the top relations carrying their supporting passages (the actual sentences, with PMIDs). Filter by relation type (treat, cause, associate, interact, inhibit, stimulate, prevent, positive/negative_correlate, cotreat, drug_interact, compare) and/or by a second entity. Accepts a PubTator id (@GENE_BRCA1) or a plain name. Sourced from the PubTator 3 relation-extraction model at NCBI/NLM — predictions from text, not curated. Keyless.

entity.description: The entity to list relations for: a PubTator id ("@GENE_BRCA1", "@CHEMICAL_Doxorubicin") or a plain name ("BRCA1", "doxorubicin") — a name is resolved via autocomplete and reported in resolved_from.

evidence_for.description: How many of the top relations get supporting passages attached (one search each), 0-5 (default 3). Each attaches up to 3 passages with PMIDs.

target.description: Optional second entity to restrict to (id or plain name), e.g. "@DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms".

type.description: Restrict to one relation type. Omit for all types.

name: pubtator_relations
title: Pubtator Relations
